convert_gltf_to_basis: run the script to convert a glTF JSON file to use BASIS texture compression format
replace_image_uris_with_basis: replace all image URIs in a glTF file with .basis extension and set mimeType to image/x-basis
add_google_texture_basis_extension: add the GOOGLE_texture_basis extension to all textures in a glTF JSON file
validate_basis_image_existence: validate that all .basis image files referenced in the glTF JSON actually exist on disk
output_modified_gltf_json: write the modified glTF JSON data with BASIS texture references to an output file
